question: Are the four preselected partial/GT files structurally usable, and can partial-derived coordinate controls be reproduced without silently changing point support?
seed_rule: seed + pair index; NumPy legacy RandomState for the pinned upstream FPS function
error_scale: max(partial radius, max absolute partial coordinate, 1); GT roundtrip also includes max absolute GT coordinate
controls: original online 7/6 restoration on copied input
diagnostics: directed nearest-point mean/p95/max in supplied coordinates
diagnostic_boundary: Nearest-point distances have no success cutoff and do not establish physical alignment, units, free space or a completion-model error.

decisions.INVALID_INPUT_OR_SOURCE_INTEGRITY: stop execution and repair the recorded input/source mismatch; no empirical interpretation
decisions.REFINE_INPUT_SCHEMA: retain all four pair outcomes; investigate shape/nonfinite/degenerate/support failure; do not replace cases or change expectations after seeing results
decisions.REFINE_COORDINATE_IMPLEMENTATION: investigate implementation/numerical controls; no model-error attribution
decisions.INPUT_CONTROLS_VALID_PHYSICAL_FRAME_UNRE: input checks passed; separately assess model loading and missing per-file physical/camera linkage before further investment

expected_point_count_basis: 3DSGrasp paper section III-A; a mismatch is an informative schema finding, not permission to silently resample GT or change the denominator
